what.text: This page follows refugees from Sudan living in Uganda, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 92692 Sudanese refugees in Uganda, 3.3% of all refugees from Sudan.
Chad hosts the most Sudanese refugees, followed by South Sudan, Libya and Ethiopia.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Southern Sudan territory from 1963 to 1972 and over the government of Sudan from 1983 to 2018, at war level in many years.
From 2020 to 2025 it records armed conflict over the government of Sudan with the SLM/A, RSF, SPLM/A-North and SFA.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1963 at 5000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 223720, at the end of 1996, and the main years of displacement in the data are 1993 to 2007.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Uganda.
These are year-end totals for Uganda only, reported to UNHCR.
